name: seamless-ai-bridge
description: An extensible chat participant for VS Code designed to route prompts to various AI models.

chatParticipants.name: bridge
chatParticipants.description: Bridge for connecting custom and self-hosted AI models.

seamlessAiBridge.path.markdownDescription: Absolute path to an external bridge CLI. If empty, the extension uses the bundled `bridge-echo.js`. You can also set the environment variables `SEAMLESS_AI_BRIDGE_PATH` or `SEAMLESS_AI_CLI_PATH`.

seamlessAiBridge.experimental.enableCros.markdownDescription: Experimental and unstable. When enabled, @bridge may attempt best-effort cross-participant command invocation before automatically falling back to the local bridge provider.
